newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia Penas Corp plans bonus issue.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia Penas Corp plans bonus issue.

text.p: Penas Corp Bhd said on Tuesday that it is proposing a bonus issue of 19.99 million new shares on the basis of one new share for every two existing shares.
The construction company said in a statement that the proposal is based on issued and paid-up capital of the company totalling 39.99 million shares.

Penas said the planned issue will be done by capitalising 19.99 million ringgit from its retained profits account. It said the issue would "better reflect" the assets employed in its current level of operations.
The issue will also strengthen its capital base and commit liquidity to its shares, it said.
The bonus issue will raise its share capital to 59.99 million from 39.99 million, it said.
